requirement_text.REQ-428: Third MOB-4 requirement. Task routes (lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex): GET /api/v1/tasks/inbox, GET /api/v1/tasks/:id, POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/claim, POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete. The task form is resolved through REQ-424's pinned resolver and rendered by REQ-427's form renderer; never the active version. Process-instance renderer: read-only view of GET /api/v1/instances/:id and /api/v1/instances/:id/timeline (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex) -- status, current step, timeline. No cancel/rebind/advance actions (not in MOB-4). All screens use REQ-426's six-state wrapper; claim/complete errors (409 already claimed, 403, 422) map to its states.

task.description: Run docs/agents/protocols/GIT_MERGE.md's full procedure on branch feature/WF02-REQ428-20261001 (this is the PRIMARY checkout, not a secondary worktree -- git worktree list to confirm before deciding which variant applies; the worktree variant almost certainly does NOT apply here). NOTE: a sibling session shares this working directory and has switched branches here at least twice during this run (observed via git reflog during Step 4/5) -- verify branch before every git-mutating command, and if you observe another switch mid-step, check back out to your own branch before continuing, same as the prior steps handled it; this is not something to escalate. Rebase onto origin/main, resolve any conflicts per the protocol's guidance (abort and escalate only if >5 files conflict or any touches lib/letflow/process_instance.ex, instance_supervisor.ex, or priv/repo/migrations/ -- unlikely here since this run never touched those), verify mix format/compile/test after rebase with structural failure attribution (expect the same pre-existing EventRetention/PartitionMaintenance failures RELEASE-VALIDATOR already cleared -- re-attribute them fresh after rebase rather than assuming they still apply unchanged), push, open the PR with the mix test attribution written into the PR body per step 7's requirement, wait for CI's backend+frontend jobs, merge (--admin only if a FAILURE check already carries attribution in the PR body), and return to main. Use DOC-UPDATER's step-06 result.summary as the PR body's Summary section. Note in the PR body or your result: 'Forwarded, not fixed here: ISS-0937, ISS-0938' for the pre-existing EventStore/retention failures. Immediately on PASS, before writing anything else: report back to ORCH so release_lock(status=done) can be called against letflow-queue task 865 -- do not call the queue yourself.

git branch --show-current is main after cleanup
git log --oneline -1 shows the squash-merge commit
PR body's mix test line names real counts and a structural attribution route, never a bare PASS next to a non-zero count
